description: Part 10 lesson 10-01, route without RPG III (fixed-form RPG IV, CRTBNDRPG), issue #35. NOT RUN YET - every expectation is in expected/notes.md and is a prediction. The converted ZA0500/JU0300/TK0100 are HAND conversions (UNVERIFIED) from src/legacy/qrpgle112; this batch also tells whether they compile. WHAT IT CHECKS: (1) the ILE job-log message ids and their order when ZA0500 reads the TXCAPST row with HEX(JUSU) 4B4B4B4B4B (decimal-data error), whether JU0900C MONMSG CPF0000 catches it, whether QSYSPRT exists afterwards, whether the submitted job ends normally; (2) the 12 baseline lines and CPF4123 with ticket 1 fixed (JU0900T1); (3) the repaired resubmit (J00000 line plus 12 lines?); (4) the symptom of the UNFIXED ticket 1 (LEN(3 0) in JU0900C against the 5,0 entry plist of the ILE ZA0500) on clean data; (5) that TXLEGACY without LANG keeps *RPGLE (default *SAME, called through TXCAPRUN); (6) the source lines of the converted ZA0500 (VFYSRCR) to map statement numbers. ORDER: helper compiles, RMVLIBLE of library 1 (helper TXRNOL, name built at run time), DBVER 1 + RPG III gate (TXRGATE, CHECK-constraint attribute gate), TXLEGACY LANG(*RPGLE) FORCE(*YES) through TXRGRUN, scratch compiles RG0500/RG0300/RG0100 with an event file (RNF ids if the hand conversion fails), post-switch gate (all three OBJATTRIBUTE RPGLE, else jump to RSTLEG), LANG-less TXLEGACY and gate again, TXRESET, ticket-1 fix, baseline, TXCAPST plant, failing run, UPDATE repair, resubmit, cleanup, the unfixed ticket-1 run LAST, then RSTLEG: TXLEGACY LANG(*RPG) FORCE(*YES), TXRESET, delete plant rows and TXCAPFL, scratch programs, final-state rows. Every submitted job copies its own QSYSPRT (CPYSPLF JOB(*)) and job log (JOBLOG_INFO(*)) inside the job (helper TXRCAP), the only routes proven in part10-01-incident; ENDJOB is issued for the two runs that may stop. Wrapper name TPART1001R. Recovery by hand if the run stops: see expected/notes.md.
